correctness.rationale: For any simple n≥7 graph with no C3,C4, reconstruct X=Alexander dual of the ordinary Δ3. Its full complete-graph one-skeleton, induced 2-edge path triangles, and absence of tetrahedra follow from every connected induced triple having exactly two edges and edge-count forcing a forbidden C4 on four vertices. Each path triangle has its endpoint nonedge as private free edge since a second common neighbor forms C4; independent collapses yield connected graph with binom(n,2)−p edges, cycle rank b=binom(n−1,2)−Σ_v binom(deg(v),2)≥0. Integral Alexander duality leaves only free H_{n−4}=Z^b. The full (n−5)-skeleton plus vanishing H_{n−5} yields (n−5)-connectivity for n−4≥3; Hurewicz and Whitehead establish wedge b S^{n−4}, including b=0 contractible. Equivariant chain exact sequence 0→signed Q[path triangles]→∧²Aug(Q^V)→H1(X;Q)→0, trace exterior-square identity and ambient orientation sign ε(g) give χ_{n−4}(g)=ε(g)((f(g)^2−f(g²))/2−f(g)+1−τ(g)). Neither equivariant wedge nor shellability claimed.
